# CHANGELOG - fR3k Cardputer 3.0.0-fr3k-lab

v3 is built on top of v2.0.0-fr3k. All v2 surface (GPS, demon renderer,
boot splash, status, branding, radio safety, farm/weather/seasons, SD/NVS
compat) is unchanged. v3 adds a runtime-lab gate, an Australian IR brand
DB, spectrum-sky telemetry overlay, demon-voice rewrite, and a 5-minute
telemetry log.

## Lab unlock (P1, P2, P3, P4, P11)

- New runtime gate at `src/lab/lab_unlock.{h,cpp}` - persists unlock flag
  + per-tool bitmask in NVS namespace `fr3klab`.
- Unlock password is `666`. The firmware never stores the cleartext; it
  stores `sha-1("666") = cd3f0c85b158c08a2b113464991810cf2cdfc387` and
  hashes typed input with the same in-firmware SHA-1 (`lab_unlock.cpp`,
  hand-rolled RFC 3174 / FIPS 180-4 implementation, dependency-free).
- New root-menu action `22 = LAB UNLOCK` opens a new `SettingsPage::LAB`
  with `PASSWORD` (text input), `LOCK NOW` (action), and per-tool toggles
  (`LIGHT / AGGRO / EVILPIG / PIGPASS / BLE / IR / SPECTRUM / LOOT`).
- v3 default env (`m5cardputer`) ships the offensive code path behind
  the gate. v2 safe env (`m5cardputer-safe`, `FR3K_SAFE_BUILD=1`)
  stays code-clean - no offensive launch paths linked.
- The gate is honored at three layers: `doAction` guard, `tryHotkey`
  guard, and `Cap::begin / EvilPigMode::init / PigpassMode::init` in
  `main.cpp` setup.
- `Config::init()` no longer force-clears the legacy radio toggles
  (`r.deauth / r.bidirKick / r.eapolTx / r.pmkidProbe / r.csaHerd /
  r.authFlood`) in the v3 default env; safe build still clears them.
- Lab row added to STATUS page (LOCKED / UNLOCKED + active tool mask
  e.g. `LIGHT AGG EP PP BLE IR SPEC LOOT`).

## Australian IR brand DB (P6)

- New `src/ir/aus_brand_db.h` (auto-generated by `tools/aus_ir_codes.py`).
- 75 entries across 4 protocols (NEC, NEC42, SAMSUNG, SONY): Telstra
  T-Box, Optus Fetch, Foxtel IQ3/IQ4, Hisense / LG / Samsung / Sharp /
  Sony AU TVs, Mitsubishi / Daikin / Panasonic / Kelvinator / Carrier /
  Bonaire split AC, Hunter Pacific / Mercator / Eglo / Beacon /
  Brilliant ceiling fans, Dimplex / Bromic heaters.
- Carrier locked to 38 kHz / 940 nm, single-shot only. No repeat codes.
  No burst mode. One frame per menu press.
- New `Pack::AU_BRANDS` in `IrPortMode` (press `V` in IR PORT to switch
  from `POWER NA/EU` to `AU BRANDS`).

## Spectrum-sky overlay (P5)

- New `src/piglet/spectrum_sky.{h,cpp}` - 13-bar 2.4 GHz RSSI histogram
  drawn between sky and clouds, no extra M5Canvas allocation.
- Fed by `Cap::RunMode::Light` when the lab is unlocked and the sniffer
  is running; passive `WiFi.scanNetworks()` poll every 5 s otherwise.
- New `SettingsPage::SCENE` row `SPECTRUM SKY` toggles the overlay.

## Demon voices + personality (P7)

- `OINK_HAPPY / GRUNT / SQUEAL / OINK` retired in favour of `ACK / HEY /
  NAH / MUM / OOF` (2-step pitch contours, 280-1100 Hz, ~80-120 ms each).
- New `SFX::CUNT` event + `SFX::playCuntJingle()` helper for the
  operator-requested personality jingle.
- New `PersonalityConfig::voiceWord` (defaults to `CUNT` per operator
  instruction) and `PersonalityConfig::cuntJingle` (opt-in).
- New `SettingsPage::SCENE` rows `SOUND WORD` (ACK/HEY/NAH/MUM/OOF/CUNT)
  and `CUNT JINGLE` (toggle).
- `Mood::feed / Mood::pet` dispatch via `SFX::playPersonality()` so every
  positive event gets the chosen demon word.

## 5-minute telemetry (P8)

- New `src/telemetry/telemetry.{h,cpp}` - 96-record ring buffer, 16 B per
  record, 5 s sample, rotated daily to
  `/0N3P0rK/telemetry/YYYY-MM-DD.md.bin` (16 KiB/day, bounded).
- Records `millis / freeHeap / largestBlock / satellites / fixAge /
  captures / dayNight`.
- STATUS page adds a TELEM row plus a single-pixel-high sparkline of
  the heap across the last 5 minutes.

## Build / verify

- `platformio.ini` env split: `m5cardputer` (default, `FR3K_SAFE_DEFAULT=0`)
  + `m5cardputer-safe` (legacy v2, `FR3K_SAFE_BUILD=1`).
- `custom_version = 3.0.0-fr3k-lab` in default env, `3.0.0-fr3k-safe`
  in safe env.
- `scripts/verify_fr3k.py` extended with v3 gates: lab namespace,
  sha-1("666") constant, demon words, CUNT event, AU brand DB entries
  (>=40), AU protocol coverage, telemetry namespace, spectrum-sky wire,
  STATUS rows.
- `tools/aus_ir_codes_test.py` asserts the generator + on-disk header
  agree and the table has >=40 entries across >=4 protocols.
- `tools/lab_unlock_check.py` re-implements the in-firmware SHA-1 in
  Python and asserts the constant matches + 11 negative cases are
  rejected.

## Compatibility

- NVS namespace unchanged: `onelpig`.
- SD root unchanged: `/0N3P0rK`.
- v3 default env (`m5cardputer`) is wire-compatible with the v2 SD and
  NVS state. Operators who upgrade from v2.0.0-fr3k see their existing
  personality, GPS settings, wolf loot, and Pig/Imp companion intact.
- The distributable `fr3k-cardputer-v3.bin` ships with the gate locked.
  Operators enter it once via `SETTINGS > LAB UNLOCK > PASSWORD > 666`.
- No firmware was flashed and no physical hardware test was claimed.

## v3.0.1-lab follow-up

- New `SFX::playNav()` — queue-bypassing nav tap that fires two short
  notes (50-60 ms total) directly via `M5.Speaker.tone()` instead of
  routing through the audio queue. The audio task pumps the second
  note in the next `update()` tick. Fixes the perceived lag where a
  visual UI update was trailed by an audible click.
- All `SFX::play(SFX::CLICK)` and `SFX::play(SFX::MENU_CLICK)` call
  sites (39 of them) migrated to `SFX::playNav()`. The dispatcher
  arms for `CLICK` and `MENU_CLICK` in `sfx.cpp` are no-ops for
  backwards source compat only.
- Mute-mask leak in `update()` fixed. The old code drained the audio
  queue when `setMuted(true)` was called (used by `IrPortMode::startBlast`
  and the spectrum hunt path). This dropped any personality event that
  was queued just before the mute toggle. v3.0.1 keeps the queue intact
  and only silences the active sequence — personality events fire
  after the mute clears, so the operator hears CUNT / HEY / etc even
  after pressing an attack hotkey.
- `applyMuteMask()` no longer calls `stop()`. The IR blast path is
  unaffected because `currentSequence = nullptr` was already wired into
  the update path.
- Personality variant table added: NAV_ACK / NAV_HEY / NAV_NAH / NAV_MUM
  / NAV_OOF / NAV_CUNT. The `SOUND WORD` setting now drives both the
  demon word events (mood / boot) AND the nav tap (UI). Default
  `voiceWord == VOICE_CUNT` produces the NAV_CUNT tap on every UI keypress.
- Verify script extended: walks every .cpp/.h in `src/` (except
  `sfx.cpp/.h`) and fails on any lingering `SFX::play(SFX::CLICK)` or
  `SFX::play(SFX::MENU_CLICK)`. Locks down the migration.

## Compatibility (v3.0.1)

- All v3.0.0 user state preserved (NVS, SD, lab unlock flag).
- `voiceWord == VOICE_CUNT` is still the shipped default. To hear the
  old "annoying click" again, set `SOUND WORD` to `ACK` and the nav tap
  reverts to NAV_ACK (~30 ms, higher pitch).
